Integrity: sha512-gApO66EMtoDZuio680RUBvskR7ahFd/NNhLN4tBAs+Y7FeT4gQV8zVFgYVMRmFxQznOEzecW19w6xOd9XjZjiA==
Published: 2026-10-25
Added: 2026-11-09

The archive's sha512 matched the registry's "dist.integrity" for maplibre-gl@6.16.0. It was unpacked into an empty
folder of its own and read before anything was copied: no hidden characters, LF line endings, no credential the
engine's scanner knows. The worker carries one globalThis.eval, on the path that loads an extra script into the
workers (importScriptInWorkers, the right-to-left text plugin); this site calls neither, and its CSP (no
'unsafe-eval', no blob: scripts) would refuse it anyway.
Copied from the archive unchanged, byte for byte: dist/maplibre-gl.mjs, dist/maplibre-gl-worker.mjs,
dist/maplibre-gl.css, LICENSE.txt. Not copied: dist/maplibre-gl-shared.mjs (empty in this version), the -dev builds,
the source maps and the type declarations.
Version 6 is an ES module only; site/js/vectormap.js gives it the global name the Leaflet bridge expects (maplibregl)
and points it at its worker file (setWorkerUrl) — ADR-0013 §1.
Kept in the site itself (ADR-0013), so a visitor's browser asks no third party for it.
tests/test_vendor.py compares every file below with its SHA-256.
